title: Stat-Split (Sixty-Four Token Window)
style: segmented breakbeat hip-hop, 95 bpm, chopped amen break with overlap motif, vocoder hook, deterministic kick on the chunk boundaries, glitchy stutter on the overlap windows, deep dusty bass, jazzy keys, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the kick, library-archive late-night mood
lyrics:
[Intro]
Sixty-four tokens, then we cut
Overlap fifty, nothing's lost

[Verse 1]
Fixed-size window, deterministic slice
Same input every time, the same advice
No semantic drift, no clever guess
Just count the tokens, mark the address

[Pre-Chorus]
Boundary, boundary, here comes the cut
Overlap saves what the boundary shut

[Chorus]
Stat-Split — chunk — Stat-Split — chunk
Overlap fifty so the meaning don't sink
Stat-Split — chunk — Stat-Split — chunk
Three-three-six on the window, never blink

[Verse 2]
The vector knows the neighbour, the neighbour knows the page
Retrieval lands the answer at the right age
No magic in the splitter, no AI in the cut
Fixed math, fixed window, fixed gut

[Chorus]
Stat-Split — chunk — Stat-Split — chunk
Overlap fifty so the meaning don't sink
Stat-Split — chunk — Stat-Split — chunk
Three-three-six on the window, never blink

[Outro]
Deterministic in, deterministic out
That's what the chunker is about
